name: @fdn/desktop
description: Cliente de escritorio de ERIS: envuelve el cliente web en Electron (Chromium propio) y lo empaqueta para Windows.

scripts.pack:win: node scripts/sync-version.cjs && pnpm --filter @fdn/client build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.pack:dir: node scripts/sync-version.cjs && pnpm --filter @fdn/client build && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.release:win: node scripts/sync-version.cjs && pnpm --filter @fdn/client build && electron-builder --win --publish always

author: ERIS
